result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and overhead traffic signals with a 'No Turn on Red' restriction. However, the wide street and lack of traffic calming measures like curb extensions or street trees create a relatively exposed environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the intersection corner.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a protected space to wait mid-crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway within the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Planting trees along the sidewalk to provide a vertical buffer and narrow the driver's field of vision, encouraging slower speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized pedestrian controls. While basic infrastructure is present, the significant crossing distance and lack of physical separation like refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend significant time in the path of vehicles without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk in the foreground spanning multiple lanes

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb side to the left of the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers by moving the waiting area forward.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages and provide a safe waiting area.

result.summary: The image shows a large, multi-lane urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and signals. However, the environment is dominated by wide roadways and a poorly maintained refuge island, leading to long crossing distances and high exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Degraded Refuge Island
hazards.description: The pedestrian refuge island has cracked, uneven pavement and lacks robust physical protection from vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground island with yellow bollards

hazards.name: Wide Turn Radii
hazards.description: The geometry of the intersection allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk during pedestrian crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the island

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Refuge Island Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and upgrade the refuge island with high-quality paving and more substantial bollards or planters for protection.

interventions.title: Tighten Corner Radii
interventions.description: Redesign the corners to have smaller radii, forcing vehicles to slow down when making turns.
